description: This file defines an abstract handler class for managing complex observation data in the OpenMRS framework. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting complex data associated with observations, as well as parsing metadata and handling storage interactions.

classes.name: AbstractHandler
classes.description: An abstract class providing convenience methods for handling complex observation data, including retrieval, storage, and deletion functionalities within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: getObsDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for complex observations based on a global property.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves an Obs object with its associated complex data loaded from storage.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves complex data for an Obs object into storage and updates the Obs with the storage key.

methods.name: purgeComplexData
methods.description: Deletes the complex data associated with an Obs from storage.

methods.name: parseDataKey
methods.description: Extracts the storage key for complex data from an Obs object.

methods.name: parseDataTitle
methods.description: Obtains the title or filename for the complex data from an Obs object.

methods.name: injectMissingMetadata
methods.description: Fills in missing metadata for ComplexData objects based on stored metadata.

methods.name: getSupportedViews
methods.description: Returns an array of supported view names for complex data display.

methods.name: supportsView
methods.description: Checks if a specific view is supported for the complex data.
